summary: Avino Silver & Gold Mines Ltd. filed a Form 6-K attaching its Notice of Meeting and Information Circular and Form of Proxy for its 2026 Annual General Meeting of Shareholders to be held on May 27, 2026. The filing is a routine regulatory submission by a foreign private issuer providing meeting materials. It contains no event-driven special situation—no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. The meeting notice and circular cover standard annual meeting items such as director elections and auditor appointments. This is a routine current report, not a special situation.
